verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Watchlist reports covering Sanctions, PEPs, Monitored Lists, and Adverse Media as part of the same platform/workflow used for identity verification (same API, same dashboard/workflow studio), satisfying the one-vendor, one-API, one-review-surface requirement. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the unified review UI or evidence of how screening results integrate into a single case review alongside document/biometric checks in practice.
